responsibility: Implements GORI (Generating Outgoing Range Information), the ranger component that discovers which SSA names can have refined ranges on outgoing edges and how those refinements depend on in-block definitions. It builds per-block dependency and import/export chains, determines when values can be recomputed on edges, computes operand ranges from edge-constrained results including logical and conditional forms, and exposes iterators and diagnostics for the resulting edge-range graph.
same_name_distinction: Implements GORI analysis and computation: building dependency/import/export information, deciding recomputation, and solving operand ranges on outgoing edges and conditional expressions. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-gori.h, it contains the actual dataflow construction and edge-range solving logic behind the declared GORI classes and iterators.
